start_port_server: start a gRPC port server process on localhost port 32766 for test infrastructure
check_port_server_version: check if a compatible port server is already running by querying its version number endpoint
kill_incompatible_port_server: kill an outdated port server process when version mismatch is detected via HTTP quit endpoint
wait_for_port_server_ready: wait for the port server to become ready by polling its HTTP get endpoint with retries
handle_port_server_startup_failure: handle port server startup failure by logging errors printing logs and exiting with code 1
